items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He made several of them while he was with the Phil Woods group. They came here a couple of times.

ctx.x: It will throw you off a little bit, but you’ve got to tune it and do other things. So, some of the other musicians... Being a drummer myself, and I’ve always loved his playing, and he was on quite a few of the Play-A-Longs... Bill Goodwin.
Yes. He made several of them while he was with the Phil Woods group. They came here a couple of times.
Did you find part of it... When they were in town for gigs, you found an opportunity?
